description: A stop-loss whose brain is a small neural network living inside a Reactive contract. It watches the Chainlink ETH/USD feed on Lasna, decides HOLD / TRIM / EXIT (and buys back in, in two tranches) entirely on-chain, and executes its own protection callbacks into a per-user pooled vault on Base Sepolia: anyone can deposit WETH for shares and redeem their own slice of the pool at any time. This manifest describes the agent connector layer: an MCP server that reads the live system and prepares — never signs, never sends — deposit transactions for an agent's own wallet.
limits: Testnet only (Lasna + Base Sepolia); nothing here is real money.
Deposits mint shares in the depositor's name (per-user accounting); any holder can redeem their own shares at any time for their pro-rata slice of both pool assets.
The guard acts on the whole pool at once, so all holders share its decisions pro-rata; a redemption pays the pool's current mix, not necessarily what was deposited.
The safe asset is MockUSDC, a mock token (owner-only mint, no public faucet).
The MCP server holds no keys and never broadcasts transactions; it only reads chains and prepares calldata.
name: Sentinel — an AI-guarded stop-loss
